<p class="role">Professor, Xishuangbanna Tropical Botanical Garden, Chinese Academy of Sciences</p>
<p class="tagline">I am a conservation scientist using quantitative and spatial methods to study human impacts on biodiversity and inform evidence-based conservation. My research integrates spatial ecology, causal inference, and acoustic monitoring to assess anthropogenic pressures and the effectiveness of conservation measures.</p>

```{=html}
<h2 class="head-row"><span>Recent studies</span><a class="head-link" href="publications.html">Publications</a></h2>
<div class="fstudies">
<article class="fs">
<h3>Large language models have potentially transformative implications for ecology and conservation science when applied responsibly.</h3>
<p>We synthesized emerging applications of large language models in conservation science, highlighting key challenges and outlining potential strategies to address them.</p>
<a class="fs-link" href="https://doi.org/10.1111/cobi.70287">Conservation Biology, 2026<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></a>
</article>
<article class="fs">
<h3>Media coverage of biodiversity falls short compared to climate change and popular culture.</h3>
<p>We showed that COP15, the summit at which the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework was adopted, attracted substantially less media coverage and public interest than the climate summit held just a month earlier, highlighting the gap in public discourse between biodiversity loss and climate change.</p>
<a class="fs-link" href="https://doi.org/10.1038/s44185-025-00082-w">npj Biodiversity, 2025<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></a>
</article>
<article class="fs">
<h3>Acoustic indices may not yet be effective for accurately monitoring bird species richness.</h3>
<p>We evaluated 60 acoustic indices across 114 sites in Cyprus, China, and Australia, revealing the persistent challenges of using these indices to accurately monitor bird species richness.</p>
<a class="fs-link" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ecolind.2025.113105">Ecological Indicators, 2025<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></a>
</article>
<article class="fs">
<h3>Land artificialization is lower inside Natura 2000 sites, but it has not been halted.</h3>
<p>Impervious surface cover was consistently lower within Natura 2000 sites across all habitats examined, yet coastal, grassland, and agricultural habitats remained vulnerable to land artificialization even within protected areas, emphasizing the need for improved management to strengthen effectiveness.</p>
<a class="fs-link" href="https://doi.org/10.1016/j.biocon.2024.110556">Biological Conservation, 2024<i class="bi bi-box-arrow-up-right"></i></a>
</article>
</div>
<a class="more-btn" href="publications.html">Publications</a>
```
